{{Top}}
{{Quote|You have two standard minutes to recall your vessels.|Darth Vader|<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
A '''standard minute''' or '''minute''', is a [[Galactic Standard Time/Legends|standardized]] measurement of [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="SOTE" /> There were sixty minutes in a [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hour]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' Note that the book erroneously states that there are 60 [[Standard second|''seconds'']] in a standard hour; this is most likely a misprint</ref>
